lesson.title: The forgotten strength
lesson.hook: cursed to forget his powers until a friend reminds him; who you are can be forgotten, not lost

title: the forgotten strength
hook: the strongest one there forgot he was strong.
cast: today: a Tamil para-athletics coach in Chennai, in a wheelchair.
